compiled_state.title: As an engineer, I can identify and remove plugin scripts made dead weight by local enforcement removal
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
After removing local enforcement hooks (5428-bebd), some plugin scripts may have no remaining consumers — they only existed to support the local enforcement path. This story covers identifying and cleaning up those dead-weight scripts.

## Done Definitions
- grep -rn scan run against plugin directories identifying scripts whose only consumers are now-removed local enforcement hooks
- Explicit candidate list produced (script paths + reason each is dead weight)
- Each candidate either deleted (if zero non-enforcement consumers) or annotated with surviving consumer reason if kept
- All remaining tests pass after removals
- Unit tests written and passing for any logic that was extracted/preserved

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Only scripts with ZERO non-enforcement consumers should be deleted; annotate survivors
- [Reliability] Verify with grep that no remaining code references deleted scripts before removal
- [Testing] Validate test suite passes after each deletion, not just at the end

comments.body:
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Enumerate specific candidate dead-weight scripts in scope

Add done definition listing the specific scripts whose dead-weight status will be evaluated: review-integrity-guard.sh, compute-diff-hash.sh, emit-review-result.sh, record-review.sh, record-test-status.sh, review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh, skip-review-check.sh, plan-review-gate.sh, review-stop-check.sh, pre-bash-functions.sh review-related sections, and the .pre-commit-config.yaml ticket-gate entries. The story also evaluates 15+ test files in tests/ for orphan tests.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Escalation policy: Escalate when blocked — Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Consideration: [Maintainability/Consumer Impact] The dead-weight scan must check FOUR consumer surfaces, not just local hook callers: (1) plugins/dso/hooks/* and pre-commit-* scripts, (2) .github/workflows/*.yml (CI may invoke ostensibly-local scripts), (3) .claude/scripts/dso shim dispatch table (host projects on enforcement.strategy=local still consume these), (4) plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh and validate.sh --ci paths. A script with zero local-hook consumers but one CI or shim consumer must be ANNOTATED, not deleted. Done sub-item: scan output enumerates consumers found in all four surfaces per candidate.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: DEAD_WEIGHT_SCAN: scan complete. candidates=none deleted=none annotated=none. All scripts referenced by enforcement hooks (pre-commit-review-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh, pre-commit-ticket-gate.sh) have consumers outside S1 (local hooks). Verified: compute-diff-hash.sh(S3), deps.sh(S3/S4), enforcement-gate.sh(S1-only but actively sourced by live config-gated hooks), merge-state.sh(S3), record-review.sh(S3/S4), review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh(sourced by review-gate.sh+dispatchers/pre-bash.sh), skip-review-check.sh(S3 harvest-worktree.sh), build-review-agents.sh(S3 scripts/), fuzzy-match.sh(S3 generate-test-index.sh), record-test-status.sh(S3 harvest-worktree.sh), ticket-exists.sh(S3 ticket-lib-api.sh), config-paths.sh(S3 classify-task.sh+validate-phase.sh). No dead-weight scripts found.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fixed: 4-surface scan complete, empty candidate list (all scripts have surviving consumers). All tests passing (49 pass, 0 fail).
